what.text: This page follows refugees from Pakistan in all host countries combined, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 90497 refugees from Pakistan.
Afghanistan hosts the largest share, 23.0%, followed by the United Kingdom, Italy and Canada.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Pakistan from 2007 to 2025, at war level in several years, with the TTP, Lashkar-e-Islam and IMU among the opponents.
It also records armed conflict over Balochistan territory in several periods from 2004, most recently with the BRAS from 2019 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 1988 at 274 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 335947, at the end of 2014, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2014 and 2015.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country, reported to UNHCR.
